subject: pathology
title: Multinodular Goitre, Papillary Cancer Orphan Annie Nuclei, Follicular and Medullary Carcinomas

steps.tx: Multinodular goitre enlarges thyroid through cycles of hyperplasia and involution under iodine deficiency or goitrogens, nodules autonomously functioning toward toxic multinodular disease in older patients. That nodular enlargement is **multinodular goitre**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Nodular, asymmetric, longstanding goitre in an older patient is multinodular disease; scan its function and airways.

steps.tx: Papillary thyroid carcinoma spreads lymphatically to neck nodes in young patients with excellent survival, psammoma bodies, and grooved coffee bean nuclei whose empty chromatin earns Orphan Annie fame. Those nuclei are **Orphan Annie eye nuclei of papillary thyroid carcinoma**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Empty grooved nuclei like Orphan Annie eyes name papillary thyroid cancer before immunostains speak.

steps.tx: Follicular carcinoma cannot be diagnosed cytologically because malignancy means capsular or vascular invasion seen only histologically, follicular adenoma its benign twin. That invasion rule is **follicular thyroid carcinoma, invasion-defined malignancy**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Follicular cytology can never promise benign; invasion on histology alone separates adenoma from carcinoma.

vis.caption: Thyroid physiology framing nodular disease assessment and function.

steps.tx: Medullary thyroid carcinoma secretes calcitonin from parafollicular C cells, amyloid stromal deposits Congo red positive, RET mutations in familial MEN2 forms earning prophylactic thyroidectomy timing. That C cell cancer is **medullary thyroid carcinoma**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Calcitonin plus amyloid stroma names medullary carcinoma; RET status decides family thyroidectomy clocks.

nodes.label: Family prophylactic surgery timed by codon

steps.tx: BRAF and RAS molecular panels refine indeterminate thyroid cytology toward surgery or surveillance while papillary microcarcinomas increasingly earn active surveillance in selected patients. That molecular triage is **molecular testing in indeterminate thyroid nodules**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Molecular panels rescue indeterminate cytology from diagnostic surgery in many thyroid nodules.

vis.caption: Thyroid carcinoma invasion patterns at the aggressive end of the spectrum.

steps.tx: Thyroid nodule workup sequences TSH, ultrasound risk pattern, and FNAC by size thresholds, suppressed TSH diverting to scintigraphy for hot nodules rarely malignant. That sequence is **thyroid nodule TSH ultrasound FNAC pathway**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: TSH first, ultrasound pattern second, needle by size and suspicion: thyroid nodules in three moves.

steps.tx: Postoperative thyroglobulin monitors differentiated thyroid cancer recurrence after total thyroidectomy and ablation, rising levels hunting residual disease by imaging. That surveillance protein is **thyroglobulin after thyroid cancer treatment**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: After total thyroidectomy, thyroglobulin becomes the tumour marker it could never be with gland intact.

steps.tx: Retrosternal goitre compresses trachea and veins behind sternum, Pemberton sign flushing face on arm raising, CT mapping surgery before airway emergencies. That thoracic inlet squeeze is **retrosternal goitre with Pemberton sign**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Arms up, face flushed: Pemberton sign warns the goitre is strangling the thoracic inlet.

nodes.label: Goitre size and tracheal deviation imaged
